map.保温时间为什么正比于厚度？: Why is holding time proportional to thickness?
map.heat 需传到心部并均匀化组织，导热与相变需要时间，故保温随有效厚度线性增加；: Heat must reach the core and homogenise the structure, and conduction plus phase transformation take time, so holding increases linearly with effective thickness. The material coefficient reflects how easy conduction and phase transformation are.
map.淬火冷却时间为什么很短？: Why is quenching cooling time so short?
map.淬火要求快速越过珠光体/贝氏体鼻尖，故冷却段系数很小（d×0.2）；实际以介质冷: Quenching must pass quickly through the pearlite or bainite nose, so the cooling stage coefficient is small (d×0.2). In practice the medium's cooling capability and workpiece size govern; the tool gives a process scheduling baseline.
